summary: Completed frontend-only regression for redesigned workspace using the public preview URL. Root auto-navigation, most core routes, directory workflows, settings persistence, responsive overflow checks, and mocked-local enrolment CRUD flow passed. One critical route crash was found.

ui_bugs.issue: Route /master-management/agent crashes to generic client-side exception screen instead of rendering shared shell/content.

integration_issues.issue: Console error indicates TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length') from DirectoryPage bundle; likely record name normalization mismatch for one or more agent mock records.

issues: Low contrast risk for small text in status/demo labels (sample measured ratios around ~3.62 to ~4.19 on tiny text), may miss WCAG AA for normal text.

action_items: Fix /master-management/agent crash by hardening agent name normalization (ensure non-empty string before any length/split usage in directory render path).
Retest all master-management directory routes after fix, especially Agent and any records with null/undefined display names.
Optionally improve small-label contrast in shell status/demo text for accessibility compliance.
critical_code_review_comments: Directory UI rendering assumes string-safe fields (e.g., name.length / split). Any undefined name in mapped mock records can crash entire route; add fallback normalization in data.ts and/or defensive rendering in DirectoryPage.

Form validation UX is currently mixed: required/email checks are enforced by native browser validation tooltips instead of unified in-app error state. Behavior works, but consistency across browsers may vary.
This preview flow is MOCKED (auth + backend services), and local record changes rely on browser localStorage keys mdi-workspace-v1-* only.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_UI_CORP_2026* local records during wizard testing, then removed them from localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated passing routes: root->/enrolment-system/dashboard, provider dashboard, admin dashboard, corporate/retail/member/policy directories, insurer/office, tpa branches, master corporate/group/broker/product, user management, provider empanel, settings, provider detailed route, provider create, and legacy routes (/tpa-management/tpa, /enrolment-system/e-cards, /provider-masters/masters, /benefits-configuration/benefits-master). Verified sidebar collapse persistence, grouped nav, search links, notifications/help drawers (Escape close), directory filters/sort/pagination/select/export CSV, settings density+rows-per-page persistence across reload/navigation, no horizontal overflow at 320/768/1024/1440/1920x800, and local wizard create/status progression/reload persistence with cleanup.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open /master-management/agent. Actual: page shows 'Application error: a client-side exception has occurred...'; workspace shell content does not render. Console: TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)' from DirectoryPage bundle. Probable root cause: at least one mapped agent record has undefined/empty name and rendering logic expects string operations (length/split/initials). Mitigation: normalize agent name to safe fallback string in data mapping and add defensive checks in directory row monogram/name rendering.
